as_told.title: Kary Mullis woke in a shed and spoke with a being

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Kary Mullis, the scientist who invented PCR (a lab method for copying DNA), had an encounter with an alien, and in one episode he calls it an abduction. Michels admits he does not remember the details, but says Mullis woke up in a shed and spoke with some kind of being. He brings it up because, if true, it would mean a celebrated scientist had a close contact experience of his own.
